scope: Nine exact owner scanner signals independently reviewed against hash-matching source; no scanner execution or registry edit by reviewer

findings.reason: Accept this cohesive document workflow owner. Its shared local draft/history, read candidate, saved baseline and pending execution must transition together; splitting these interlocks into independent owners risks old receipts overwriting new work. It delegates wire validation/transport, cross-navigation fencing, React subscription lifetime and HTML display to separate canonical modules. The synchronous active guard, ticket-before-dispatch ordering and repeated current-execution checks are reviewed explicitly. It does not add backend authorization, providers or durable storage.

Accept the focused finite controller/QueryClient suite. Public factories plus the real shared adapter and intercepted fetch test actual protocol boundaries without a backend or unrelated graph. Five semantic groups share fixtures to compare full request bodies, current state, draft retention and disposal; original draft/browser assertions remain unchanged.

Accept the grouped conflict/uncertainty controls: whole draft retention, exact CAS, explicit current read/adopt or rebase, malformed/wrong receipt refusal and creation noncausation. The group is one recovery boundary, not unrelated subsystems.

Accept the grouped current-read, saved-preview and stage controls. They distinguish server-only preview from local content, deny stale actionable reads, preserve UUID-case identity and retain same-revision stage uncertainty through adoption.
Accept the grouped late completion/disposal controls. Held create/save/stage/preview and 200/403/503 outcomes verify that a disposed execution cannot restore private material to a remounted owner.

Accept the grouped navigation-journal controls. Actual QueryClient and adapter observations verify pending-before-dispatch, same-cache fences, explicit save review, both cleanup orders, no refetch/GC and reentrant settlement disposal. Preserved failures demonstrate the regression assertions exercise real incorrect prior behavior.

Accept one feature-local adapter for one QueryClient journal. Begin, finish and explicit save review share the same attempt/status identity rules; keeping them together exposes the non-replay invariant. Exact document/revision pairs and case-insensitive UUID matching are distinct from server causality. The journal stores no draft/response/HTML, adds no fetcher/retry, and finish refuses to recreate a removed ticket. Canonical QueryClient replacement owns scope disposal.

Accept cohesive presentation of one saved-document lifecycle: action availability, read/adopt/rebase decision, draft/receipt distinction and truthful uncertainty text. It invokes the controller only and introduces neither transport nor inferred authorization. Stage routes are displayed as data; unsupported delivery/collaboration stays unavailable.

Accept existing rich editor composition plus its local selection, display and close-confirmation state. Document/history transitions are delegated to the controller. Pending fieldsets are disabled/inert, and owner/editorRevision replacement resets transient or editor-local state. Wire/transport/cache/sanitization remain separately owned.
